meta.title: Designing a Puzzle Box
meta.description: Sketches, prototypes, and the first working mechanism.
meta.author: Shasa Bolton

blocks.content:
Every puzzle box starts as a rough sketch on paper. The goal is a satisfying *click* when the secret panel moves — without giving away the mechanism too early.

This dummy post walks through the early stages: sizing the box, choosing wood thickness, and testing a single sliding panel before adding layers.
Next steps: refine the tolerances, add a second secret compartment, and test with fresh eyes (always the best QA).
